business_problem: AKIDS needed an ERP and analytics platform that could support omnichannel retail, deliver better visibility into customer preferences, automate warehouse and back-office operations, and scale as the company expanded across multiple countries.
solution_summary: AKIDS worked with IBM Business Partner BiLumina to deploy an ERP platform built on IBM Db2 and extend it with IBM Cognos Analytics. More than 500 business processes were brought onto the BiLumina platform, giving AKIDS a single operating core for finance, sales, distribution, warehouse management, loyalty, and international e-commerce. All business logic runs inside IBM Db2, which keeps response times low during peak retail periods and provides real-time visibility into stock levels, orders, and customer activity. The retailer uses segmentation tools in BiLumina connected to Facebook and Google Analytics to target promotions by recency, frequency, and value, while Cognos Analytics helps teams drill deeper into customer behavior and market opportunities. The same platform connects directly to suppliers and delivery providers, supports omnichannel experiences such as reserve-online-buy-in-store, and underpins the company's growing B2B supplier portal.

solution_components.name: IBM Db2
solution_components.role: Provides the transactional and business-logic backbone for BiLumina ERP across AKIDS' omnichannel retail operations.

solution_components.name: IBM Cognos Analytics
solution_components.role: Adds deeper customer and business analysis on top of AKIDS' ERP and loyalty data.

data_flow: Sales, inventory, loyalty, supplier, and e-commerce data flow through the BiLumina ERP platform on IBM Db2, where warehouse and order processes are automated and customer segments are built; Cognos Analytics then surfaces deeper insights for tailored promotions and strategic retail decisions.
business_outcome: AKIDS grew online and in-store sales, shortened delivery times, improved on-time fulfillment, expanded internationally with standardized processes, and created more targeted omnichannel experiences that drive customer loyalty.
